fact: An AIMF project co-financed by the EU, running 2011-2016 with EUR 1.5m, includes addressing in Bangui: address cells, an address plan, door numbering, an address file and street signs, linked to a census of taxable activities.
The Bangui municipality launched a street naming and house numbering project on 14 April 2012, piloted in the 6th arrondissement, co-funded by the European Union and AIMF over 36 months.
